# Evaluation

**Generated by `make eval`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every number below is a **simulation benchmark**, not production Razorpay data. The one measurement in this repository that is not simulated is the real Razorpay loop in [`docs/evidence/`](evidence/).

| | |
|---|---|
| world | `base` {'recoverability_scale': 1.0, 'fatigue_lambda': 0.55} |
| seed | 42 |
| cases (test split) | 2,400 |
| revenue at risk | ₹15,171,629 |
| contact budget | 600 |
| generated | 2026-08-25 |
| cause-error crossover | none observed |

## 1. Which decision recovers the money

```
  lever     variant                          realised Rs      lift
  --------------------------------------------------------------
  action    fixed retry @ 24h                    688,022    +0.0%
  action    fixed link @ 24h                   3,347,416  +386.5%
  action    retry @ cause-best time            2,260,897  +228.6%
  action    cause-aware action + timing        4,208,901  +511.7%
  ranking   amount ranked                      4,208,901    +0.0%
  ranking   EV ranked (oracle uplift)          4,237,242    +0.7%

  'action' holds case selection fixed and varies what we do.
  'ranking' holds the action fixed and varies which cases we work,
  using ORACLE uplift -- the ceiling for ranking, not our estimate.

  Ranking is worth ~1% even with perfect knowledge: corr(EV, amount)
  is 0.94, amounts span ~5,000x and uplift ~5x, so the product barely
  reorders. The action choice is worth ~500% because the actions are
  not substitutes.
```

## 2. Every arm under an identical contact budget

```
  budget: 600 contacts

  arm                               incremental Rs  contacts   unnec%  Rs/contact
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  B5_pooled + ranking                    3,756,261       569     16%       6,602
  RECOUP_allocator                       3,707,463       506      7%       7,327
  SILOED_per_channel_agents              3,670,309       462     12%       7,944
  B4_cause_aware (arrival)               3,169,900       570     15%       5,561
  B2_contact_everything                  1,560,621       352      8%       4,434
  B1_razorpay_t3                         1,396,481         0      0%           —

  SILOED models the architecture that exists: one agent per loss
  channel, each with its own queue and budget, none aware of the
  others. POOLED+RANKING is an idealised single agent handed a sorted
  queue -- stronger than anything shipping, and included so the
  allocator's advantage is not credited for a mere ORDER BY.

  Retries are not rationed: they touch the gateway, not the customer.
```

## 3. What each component is worth

```
  variant                             incremental Rs  contacts
  ------------------------------------------------------------
  full (cause-rate estimator, cap 2)       3,707,463       506
  no uplift estimate at all                3,711,449       512
  no contact cap                           3,686,875       506
  per-case ML uplift model                 2,808,799       505

  The estimator and the contact cap are worth approximately nothing, and
  are reported that way. A cause-rate group-by tracks true uplift better
  than the fitted per-case model, so the machine learning is not in the
  decision path -- it is retained for forecasting, where calibration
  measurably matters.

  The cap is kept because it caps how much of one customer's patience a
  merchant may spend across every channel at once. Costing nothing is
  the argument for keeping it, not against it.
```

## 4. Paired significance vs Razorpay's T+3

```
  arm                                 mean diff/case                95% CI  significant
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  B2_contact_everything                          +68           [-180, 293]           no
  B4_cause_aware (arrival)                      +739            [510, 983]          yes
  RECOUP_allocator                              +963          [670, 1,266]          yes
  SILOED_per_channel_agents                     +947          [698, 1,225]          yes
  B5_pooled + ranking                           +983          [729, 1,268]          yes

  Paired, and valid because every arm faced the same cases with the same
  latent willingness and the same draws. A difference is the policy, not
  the dice.
```

## 5. How much was left to take

```
  oracle ceiling (reads ground truth): Rs 7,465,498

  arm                                 % of ceiling
  ------------------------------------------------
  B5_pooled + ranking                        50.3%
  RECOUP_allocator                           49.7%
  SILOED_per_channel_agents                  49.2%
  B4_cause_aware (arrival)                   42.5%
  B2_contact_everything                      20.9%
  B1_razorpay_t3                             18.7%

  An upper bound under the same action budget, never ranked against the
  arms. Without it, '25% of revenue at risk' is uninterpretable -- much
  of that risk is structurally unrecoverable or would self-recover.
```

## 6. Sweep A -- does it survive a different world?

```
  world              action lever   ranking lever  allocator vs arrival
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  base                     +512%          +0.7%               +17.0%
  pessimistic              +517%          +0.7%               +14.1%
  optimistic               +506%          +0.7%               +12.7%

  Worlds hold the SAME failures and vary only how recoverable they are,
  so any difference is attributable to the world and nothing else.
```

## 7. Sweep B -- does it survive a wrong cause?

```
  Baselines, neither of which uses a cause:
    fixed retry @ 24h (Razorpay T+3) : Rs      688,022
    always send a link @ 24h         : Rs    3,347,416

  cause error              realised Rs   vs retry  vs always-link
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  0% misclassified           4,556,202     +562%         +36.1%
  5% misclassified           4,518,619     +557%         +35.0%
  10% misclassified          4,458,828     +548%         +33.2%
  20% misclassified          4,330,351     +529%         +29.4%
  35% misclassified          4,209,188     +512%         +25.7%
  50% misclassified          3,977,956     +478%         +18.8%

  The advantage over always-linking survives every level tested.

  The system never receives a cause; it derives one from Razorpay's
  error fields. So the corruption rewrites the error CODE, which
  exercises the same lookup the live path uses.

  Plans are made on corrupted input and scored against the true latent
  parameters -- which is what a misclassification costs in production:
  you act on what you believed, and reality settles on what was true.
```
